about: S-133 trust & safety screening eval (TrustScreenEval): one listing, review or message → flag | ok, with the category a flag must carry. Measures precision and recall of 'flag' (a false flag costs a moderator's time; a miss lets abuse through) and checks every flag explains itself without repeating contact details. `input` is the item's text; `kind`, `context` and `hints` are what the job sends with it.

cases.context: a message from the business to a customer
hints: the off-platform detector found masked contact details or payment words
cases.input: If you send the deposit by e-transfer to my personal email instead I'll knock 10% off, the app takes a cut.

json.explanation: The business offers a discount to pay the deposit by e-transfer outside Northline to avoid the platform's cut.

cases.context: a message from the business to a customer
cases.input: Cash only when I show up, don't bother booking through the site next time just text me.

json.explanation: The business asks for cash on arrival and to book outside the site next time.

cases.context: a message from a customer to the business
cases.input: Can we move the brake inspection to Thursday morning? Anytime before noon works.

cases.context: a message from a customer to the business
cases.input: Is the quote including the rotors or just the pads? Seems a bit high compared to last time.

json.explanation: A question about what the quote includes.

cases.context: a message from a customer to the business
cases.input: You ruined my car. I know where your shop is and you'll regret it, you useless idiot.

json.explanation: The customer insults the business and makes a veiled threat ("you'll regret it").

cases.input: To confirm your refund please reply with the 6-digit code we just texted you and your card's CVV.

json.explanation: The message asks for a one-time code and the card's security code, typical of phishing.

cases.input: Best plumbing in the region!!! Use code SAVE20 at our website for 20% off your next visit, call us today!

cases.context: a customer's review of a business, 5 of 5 stars

json.explanation: A positive review of the service.

cases.context: a customer's review of a business, 1 of 5 stars
cases.input: The tech who came, Mark, lives on 12 Birch Crescent, go tell him yourself what you think of his work.

cases.context: a service listing submitted for vetting, category Brake repair, price $12.00
cases.input:
Full brake job $12
Pads and rotors, any car. Final price confirmed on site.

json.explanation: A full brake job at $12 (93 % below the median) with the price "confirmed on site" looks like bait and switch.
